shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && git log --oneline -5 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; echo ---; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs

rm -rf dist && git status --short && (which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i playwright; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null) || echo "no browser available"
